description: This Java source file contains a test class 'CuttlefishDisplayHotplugTest' that verifies the behavior of display hotplugging (connecting and disconnecting displays) on a Cuttlefish device. It includes methods for managing displays, parsing display information, and ensuring no memory leaks occur during repeated connect/disconnect cycles.

classes.name: HostDisplayInfo
classes.description: Represents display information as seen from the host, including display ID, width, and height.

classes.name: GuestDisplayInfo
classes.description: Represents display information as seen from the guest, including display ID, width, and height.

classes.name: AddDisplayParams
classes.description: Parameters for adding a display, including width and height.

classes.name: MemoryInfo
classes.description: Holds information about used RAM in bytes.

methods.name: runCvdCommand
methods.description: Executes a command related to 'cvd' binary with specified arguments.

methods.name: parseHostDisplayInfos
methods.description: Parses JSON output to extract host display information.

methods.name: parseGuestDisplayInfos
methods.description: Parses JSON output to extract guest display information.

methods.name: getDisplayHotplugHelperAppOutput
methods.description: Starts the helper app and retrieves display info output from logcat.

methods.name: getGuestDisplays
methods.description: Retrieves guest display information by invoking the helper app.

methods.name: getHostDisplays
methods.description: Lists host displays via 'cvd display list' command.

methods.name: addDisplays
methods.description: Adds multiple displays with specified parameters.

methods.name: addDisplay
methods.description: Adds a single display with specified width and height.

methods.name: removeDisplay
methods.description: Removes a single display by ID.

methods.name: doOneConnectAndDisconnectCycle
methods.description: Performs a connect-disconnect cycle of displays and verifies state consistency.

methods.name: testDisplayHotplug
methods.description: Test case for hotplugging a single display.

methods.name: testDisplayHotplugMultipleDisplays
methods.description: Test case for hotplugging multiple displays simultaneously.

methods.name: getMemoryInfo
methods.description: Retrieves current memory usage info from the device.

methods.name: doCheckForLeaks
methods.description: Checks for memory leaks by comparing RAM usage before and after cycles.

methods.name: testDisplayHotplugDoesNotLeakMemory
methods.description: Repeatedly connects and disconnects displays to ensure no memory leaks occur.
